---
title: "Manuscript: MPX NYC Intervention Strategy"
---



```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| label: fig-networkcommunities
#| fig-cap: "Age of MPX NYC Participants"
#| 


targets::tar_read(places_data) %>%
   transmute(from = home_community, to = place_community) %>%
   group_by(from, to) %>%
   summarize(weight = n()) %>%
   ggplot() +
   geom_tile(aes(x = from, y = to, fill = weight)) +
   scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = dark_blue) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text = element_text()
  ) 





```
